contexts.text: God shall enlarge Japheth () = the enlightenment thereof. In the literal sense, to enlarge = to enlarge the borders, but in the internal sense, to enlighten; for enlightenment is the enlargement as it were of the boundaries of wisdom and intelligence, as in Isaiah: Enlarge the place of thy tent... () = enlightenment in spiritual things. The man of the external Church is enlarged when he is instructed in the truths and goods of faith.
To enlarge over the people () = falsity.
For now Jehovah maketh us to be enlarged () = the increments of truth thence... To be enlarged = to receive increments of truth.
I will make thy border to be enlarged () = the multiplication and extension of truth from good. Explained.
The alternate... enlargements and contractions of the heart and lungs...
The phylacteries which they enlarge () = goods in the external form...
Man is in the midst of infernal Societies from birth, and he extends himself into them exactly as he extends the evil affections of the will.
